instruction: A bullet-shaped pneumatic tube capsule with riveted brass hoops, a leather sealing gasket and a hinged porthole hatch showing rolled letters inside. Copper pressure gauges, a tiny governor flywheel and a chained address tag cluster around the nose cone. Aged patina, oil smudges and slotted screws detail every band of the lacquered barrel.
